# AI Engineer at Acme Corp

Sampletown NSW · Hybrid (2 days in the office) · Full time · $140k-$160k + super

## About us

Acme Corp makes scheduling software for 2,000 clinics across Australia and New Zealand. Physios, dentists and GPs use us to run their day: bookings, reminders, waitlists and payments. We are a team of about 300, and 60 of us are engineers.

Clinic staff ask the same questions all day. Can this patient move to Friday? What is our cancellation policy? Which forms does a new patient need? The answers live in each clinic's own policies, and they differ from clinic to clinic.

## The role

We are building an assistant that answers staff questions from each clinic's own policies, and takes simple actions when asked. It is in a pilot with 40 clinics. You will join a team of four engineers, a designer and a product manager, and help take it to every clinic this year.

## What you'll do

- Build LLM agents that answer questions and take simple actions, like moving a booking.
- Own retrieval: chunking, embeddings, reranking and citations.
- Set up evaluation so we know when a change makes answers worse.
- Work with product and design on how the assistant shows its sources.
- Look at real questions from the pilot each week and decide what to fix next.

## What you'll bring

- 3+ years building software in Python or TypeScript.
- Hands-on work with LLM APIs and retrieval (RAG) in production.
- A habit of measuring quality with test sets, not gut feel.
- Clear writing. You will explain trade-offs to non-engineers.

## Nice to have

- Postgres and pgvector.
- Agent frameworks or tool calling.
- Healthcare or scheduling products.

## What we offer

- $140k-$160k base plus super, reviewed every year.
- Two days a week in our Sampletown office, the rest from home.
- $2,000 a year for learning, plus time to use it.
- 18 weeks paid parental leave for any parent.
- A new laptop and a home office budget.

## Work rights

Visa sponsorship available for the right candidate. Tell us in your application if you will need it, so we can plan the timing with you.

## How to apply

Apply through the button on this page with your resume and a short note. Tell us about one LLM feature you shipped and how you knew it was working. Riley Chen from our talent team reads every application and replies within a week.

Our process: a 30 minute call with Riley, a technical chat with two engineers, and a paired session on a small retrieval problem. No take-home task.

# AI Developer (via Acme Recruiting)

Sampletown NSW · Onsite · 6-month contract, possible extension · Daily rate

## About Acme Recruiting

Acme Recruiting places software and data people with government and enterprise clients in New South Wales. We have worked with this client for six years, and most of our contractors stay on past their first contract.

## About the client

Our client is a state government agency that manages licences and permits. Its staff answer thousands of questions a month from a library of policy documents, some of them hundreds of pages long. The team wants an internal chatbot that finds the right policy and quotes it, so staff can answer faster and more consistently.

## The role

You will join a small delivery team of three developers, a business analyst and a product owner from the agency. The first version is a pilot for one service centre. If it works, it rolls out to every centre next year.

## Responsibilities

- Build an internal chatbot over policy documents, with answers that quote their source.
- Set up retrieval over long documents: parsing, chunking and search.
- Write tests that check answers against a list of known questions.
- Work with the business analyst to collect questions from staff.
- Document the system so the agency's own team can run it after the contract.

## Requirements

- Python and an LLM API.
- Experience with retrieval over long documents.
- 3+ years of professional software development.
- Clear communication with non-technical people.
- Must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident. A police check applies before you start.

## Nice to have

- Work in government or another regulated setting.
- Azure or another cloud the client already uses.

## Contract details

- Six months, starting as soon as checks are done, with a likely extension.
- Daily rate, paid weekly. Tell us your rate when you apply.
- Five days a week onsite at the client's Sampletown office. Laptop provided.

## How to apply

Reply to this ad or email Jordan Lee at jordan.lee@example.com with your resume and your daily rate. Shortlisted people will hear from Jordan within two working days. The client interviews in one round: a 45 minute chat with the delivery lead and product owner.

jobs.description:
# Backend Engineer (LLM) at Example Labs

Remote Australia · Full time · $135k-$150k + super

## About Example Labs

Example Labs builds document search for law firms. Lawyers use us to find the one clause that matters in a pile of contracts, court files and emails. Our backend serves 40 million pages and an LLM answer layer on top. We are 70 people, fully remote across Australia, and we meet in person twice a year.

## The role

Our customers upload more every month, and the biggest matters now run to hundreds of thousands of pages. We need another backend engineer to keep ingestion fast, search accurate and answers quick as we grow. You will join the platform squad of five and report to our Head of Engineering.

## What you'll do

- Design and run Node.js services for ingestion, search and answers.
- Build retrieval pipelines: parsing, chunking, embeddings and hybrid search.
- Keep latency low and costs predictable as usage grows.
- Write clear design notes before big changes, and review your teammates' notes.
- Join the on-call roster (one week in six). Pages are rare, and we fix the cause the next day.

## You have

- 4+ years of backend work in Node.js or TypeScript.
- Production experience with Postgres and queues.
- Built or run a retrieval pipeline.
- Comfort reading traces and fixing slow paths.

## Bonus

- Experience with legal or other long documents.
- Go. A few of our older services use it.

## How we work

We write things down. Most decisions start as a one-page note in our wiki, and meetings are short. Core hours are 10am to 3pm Sydney time, and the rest of your day is yours to plan. Every engineer ships to production in their first two weeks.

## What we offer

- $135k-$150k base plus super.
- Work from anywhere in Australia, with a $1,500 home office budget.
- Two team weeks a year, travel paid.
- 20 days of leave, plus your birthday off.
- A yearly learning budget of $1,500.

## How to apply

Send your resume through our careers page. Skip the cover letter. Instead, answer one question in a few sentences: what is the slowest query you have fixed, and how did you find it?

Casey Park from our talent team will be in touch within five working days. The process is a call with Casey, a system design chat, and a code review exercise on a real pull request.
